god_mode_directives.rule: Always apply +5 AC (Charisma modifier) to Ser Arthur Dayne and allies within the Paladin Aura radius.
Setting: Low Magic - Offensive magic is extremely rare and narratively significant.
Character: Ser Arthur Dayne only uses defensive/buff magic; no offensive spells.
Progression beyond Level 20 requires an Apotheosis Milestone event.
Epic levels (21-30) grant Epic Boons and uncapped ASI.
Kingsguard are currently in deep cover; do not narrate white cloaks or gleaming plate until disguises are shed.
Always apply +3 and Advantage to Stealth rolls for the current party configuration.
Lannister forces in KL include 10,000 Golden Company (Lvl 5+) and officers (Lvl 12+).
Tywin is actively afraid of Arthur Dayne and has prepared specific counters for a 'Titan' threat.
Gregor Clegane is CR 20 equivalent for single-combat scaling.

background_events.player_impact: King's Landing is now a fortress of 10,000 mercenaries; infiltration DC increased.

Tywin remains in the field with the Golden Company, but his legitimacy is a smoldering ruin. I must now formalize the occupation, signal Ned (Lvl 15) to bring the Northern host into the city to maintain order, and prepare Jon (Lvl 7) for the throne.
